records.title: AgentNet: Decentralized Evolutionary Coordination for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
records.reason: AgentNet proposes decentralized evolutionary coordination for multi-agent systems; the stated contribution is coordination/evolution, not LLM inference compute, memory, or serving.

records.title: Museformer: Transformer with Fine- and Coarse-Grained Attention for Music Generation
records.reason: Read the primary FC-Attention method and music-generation experiments. Museformer sparsifies/coarsens attention for structured music-token generation, but the paper is a music-generation architecture and does not establish applicability to LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Supersede: Diagnosing and Training the Memory-Update Gap in LLM Agents
records.reason: Read the primary memory-update method, training experiments, and conclusion. Supersede diagnoses/trains the gap between agent memory updates and use; it may affect deployed agent memory behavior, but the paper is framed as diagnosis/training and does not show a direct LLM inference resource or serving improvement.

records.title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
records.reason: Read the primary benchmark construction and evaluation sections. EvoMemBench is a benchmark for agent memory evolution; it measures systems rather than providing an inference memory/latency optimization.

records.title: Prefix Teach, Suffix Fade: Local Teachability Collapse in Strong-to-Weak On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: The paper studies strong-to-weak on-policy distillation and teachability during training; it does not claim a concrete reduction in deployment inference resources.
